QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] A Blue Dragon Cannon of My Own
QuestInfo.0: The Blue Dragon Cannon is very powerful... It's tempting.
QuestInfo.1: You contacted Coney to get a Blue Dragon Cannon of your own. Go to the #bBack Alley#k and hand #bConey#k the Blue Dragon Cannon restoration plans you copied earlier.
QuestInfo.2: You handed the copy of the Blue Dragon Cannon plans to Coney. Coney was quite interested, and decided to make an improved model.
